actions.action: Check soil moisture 5 cm deep with finger every 3-4 days
Water thoroughly until it drains, then empty saucer after 15 minutes
Snip off fully yellow/brown leaves at base with alcohol-wiped scissors
Move plant within 1-2 m of a bright window out of harsh direct sun
